basic_details.job_title: Collector Office, Bharuch Woman Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Women advocates with at least seven years of active practice, aged not less than 30 and not more than 55 years, can apply for one Woman Public Prosecutor post in the Special POCSO Court at Bharuch. The Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Bharuch (કલેક્ટર અને જિલ્લા મેજિસ્ટ્રેટની કચેરી) is preparing a panel for the post. Applicants must have paid income tax for at least 3 years before appointment, and the application form must be sent by speed post only so that it reaches the office by 23 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the office website bharuch.nic.in (the same format is printed on pages 3 to 5 of the notice).
Paste a recent passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign across it.
Fill in complete details in the form, addressed to the District Magistrate, Bharuch.
Attach certified copies of proof of birth date, experience and educational qualification certificates, along with the income tax returns of the last three years.
List the certified copies attached in the annexure table (serial numbers 1 to 10) at the end of the form.
Send the application by speed post only to Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001, so that it reaches by 23 November 2026.
Full name with surname, present and permanent address, telephone and mobile number.
Date of birth and age on the application date (certificate to be attached), birthplace, nationality and mother tongue.
Educational qualification (certificates to be attached) and details of passing the law graduate or equivalent examination.

Date of registration as an advocate under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961 (copy of Sanad to be attached), and the date and court where practice began, with that court's certificate (copy to be attached).
Type-wise and year-wise annual income and income tax for the last three years (copies of filed returns must be attached), and any other qualifications with certified proof.

Whether any police case is registered or any court case is pending against the applicant; criminal cases conducted in the last three years, how many succeeded and how many were appealed; any earlier or present service as Public Prosecutor or Additional Public Prosecutor, with the period and dates.
important_instructions: Applications with incomplete details will not be considered. Applications received after the prescribed deadline will not be considered. Applications are accepted by speed post only. Office contact: phone 02642-243751, email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About Bharuch Collector Office
content_sections.text: The Office of the Collector and District Magistrate is the district administration office of Bharuch, located on the First Floor, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001. Acting on instructions of the Home Department circular No. HD/MIS/e-file/8/2026/3525/L-1 dated 17 July 2026, the Government has decided to form a panel to fill one Woman Public Prosecutor post (under Section 32 of the POCSO Act, 2012) for the Special POCSO Court in the District Court, Bharuch. The panel is being prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules, 2026. The notice carries File No. BHR/abcd/e-file/442/2026/7547/MAG-2 and Letter No. BHR/0134/11/2026, and is signed by Dr. Navnath Gavhane, District Magistrate, Bharuch.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from law graduates who meet all of the following conditions: Active as a woman advocate for at least seven years. Age not less than 30 (thirty) years and not more than 55 (fifty-five) years. An income tax payer for a period of at least 3 years before the appointment.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate appointed to the post will receive fees and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules, 2026. The notice does not print an amount. The appointee can discharge her duties up to a maximum age of 60 (sixty) years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bharuch Collector Woman Public Prosecutor (POCSO)
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the office website bharuch.nic.in (the same format is printed on pages 3 to 5 of the notice). Paste a recent passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign across it. Fill in complete details in the form, addressed to the District Magistrate, Bharuch. Attach certified copies of proof of birth date, experience and educational qualification certificates, along with the income tax returns of the last three years. List the certified copies attached in the annexure table (serial numbers 1 to 10) at the end of the form. Send the application by speed post only to Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001, so that it reaches by 23 November 2026. Full name with surname, present and permanent address, telephone and mobile number. Date of birth and age on the application date (certificate to be attached), birthplace, nationality and mother tongue. Educational qualification (certificates to be attached) and details of passing the law graduate or equivalent examination. Date of registration as an advocate under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961 (copy of Sanad to be attached), and the date and court where practice began, with that court's certificate (copy to be attached). Type-wise and year-wise annual income and income tax for the last three years (copies of filed returns must be attached), and any other qualifications with certified proof. Whether any police case is registered or any court case is pending against the applicant; criminal cases conducted in the last three years, how many succeeded and how many were appealed; any earlier or present service as Public Prosecutor or Additional Public Prosecutor, with the period and dates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: When candidates are called for an interview, they must attend at their own expense with original certificates on the fixed date, time and place. The notice does not give the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bharuch Collector Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Woman Public Prosecutor post for the Special POCSO Court at Bharuch.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Collector office, Bharuch by speed post by 23 November 2026; late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Applicants must be law graduates who have been active as women advocates for at least seven years and have been income tax payers for at least 3 years before appointment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must be not less than 30 years and not more than 55 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What will the Woman Public Prosecutor be paid?
faq.answer: The appointee will receive fees and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Bharuch POCSO Court Public Prosecutor post?
faq.answer: Download the form from bharuch.nic.in, fill in complete details, attach the certified copies and last three years' income tax returns, and send it by speed post only to the Collector office, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be an interview?
faq.answer: Candidates called for an interview must attend at their own expense with original certificates on the fixed date, time and place.

faq.question: Q8. Can male advocates apply?
faq.answer: No, the post is for a woman Public Prosecutor, and applicants must have been active as women advocates for at least seven years.

faq.question: Q9. Up to what age can the appointee serve?
faq.answer: The appointee can discharge her duties up to a maximum age of 60 years.
